definitions.explanation: The act of conveying thoughts, feelings, or ideas through words, art, or other means. Also refers to the way something is expressed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{気持|きも}ち→気持ち：01385_kimochi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{表現|ひょうげん}する⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: It's difficult to express feelings in words.

notes:
{表現|ひょうげん} covers any form of expression — verbal, artistic, written, or emotional. It functions both as a noun ("an expression") and as a する verb ("to express").

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {表現|ひょうげん}する: to express
- ⟦{表現|ひょうげん}{力|りょく}→表現力：21315_hyougenryoku⟧: expressive ability
- {表現|ひょうげん}⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧: way of expressing
- ⟦{自己|じこ}{表現|ひょうげん}→自己表現：24700_jikohyougen⟧: self-expression
- {表現|ひょうげん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{豊|ゆた}か→豊か：03654_yutaka⟧: rich in expression

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{言|い}い{方|かた}→言い方：14165_iikata⟧: way of saying something (more casual, spoken language)
- ⟦{描写|びょうしゃ}→描写：05516_byousha⟧: depiction, description (more literary/visual)

USAGE:
In language study, {表現|ひょうげん} often refers to set phrases or ways of saying things: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{表現|ひょうげん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧ですか (Is this expression natural?).
